name: ARA-EXP-AND-008
title: Android Rust targets missing
summary: Doctor did not find both Android Rust targets. This is a warning for developing templates/native plugins; the prebuilt-template lane itself does not compile Rust.
html:
Doctor did not find both Android Rust targets. This is a warning for developing templates/native plugins; the prebuilt-template lane itself does not compile Rust.

#Common causes

  • The active toolchain lacks aarch64-linux-android, x86_64-linux-android or both.

#Fixes

  • Run rustup target add aarch64-linux-android x86_64-linux-android.
